title: Make What's next? a durable recommendation
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and mandatory hook results recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack, keep PRs open and unmerged; Q-18 optional module seam.

baseline_review.comparison: Pinned source blobs match current main and F12. Main has no durable recommendation provider. Q18 provides the planner, D10 the optional presentation binding; neither is duplicated.
baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F12 Tests, Docker and active platform checks all pass.

figma.visual: Backend provider/API; D-track presentation binding remains separate.

activation.quality_module: Q18 next-action-v1, fixed optional source path; absent or incompatible means unavailable

implementation: Bounded, allowlisted Q18 plan snapshots with durable request and recommendation identities, goal context, evidence, rationale, action and expiry.
Read-only return/reopen; explicit refresh, dismissal, ask/none, expiry and changed-context states. Fresh basis and choice checked within the acceptance write lock.
Atomic canonical work create/link, persisted queue placement and idempotent acceptance receipt. Existing front, linked work titles/intent and goal progress are preserved.
Authenticated no-store generation/read/dismiss/accept routes; default-off registration and protected settings environment entry.

actual_q18.method: Temporary overlay of five Q18 source/test/scenario files, removed in finally; no Q18 source committed.

fixes: Latest uses insertion order even when wall clock reverses.
Changed planner choice invalidates a plan even when basis is unchanged.

verification.guards: Normal mandatory EE, migration, template, package, related tests and TypeScript commit hooks; exact outcome in PR description.
verification.live_provider: not_run; Q18 planning is deterministic; no external model, message, workflow execution or production activation.

limitations: Q18 remains on its own branch; the independent F stack correctly reports unavailable until integrated.
D10 must adapt ask/none/null-goal cases and distinguish explanatory action title from an existing canonical destination title; live UI binding is not included.
At the numeric placement bound acceptance fails atomically, requiring user reordering.
Stored results are at most 64 KB. Snapshot read volume and ranking semantics remain Q18-owned.
Full repository CI reports separately on the PR.
rollback: Unset recommendation flag and restart; retain additive metadata, canonical work and receipt history.
